# vcp_servers (Data Source)

Fetches the list of all servers in the project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all servers in the project.
data "vcp_servers" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `servers` (Attributes List) List of servers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers))

<a id="nestedatt--servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `servers`

Read-Only:

- `affinity_group_id` (String) Affinity group ID (empty if none).
- `cpu` (Number) Number of CPU cores.
- `created` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Server ID.
- `image_id` (String) OS image ID the server was created from.
- `is_power_on` (Boolean) Whether the server is powered on.
- `location_id` (String) Location ID.
- `name` (String) Server name.
- `nics` (Attributes List) Network interfaces of the server. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers--nics))
- `ram_mb` (Number) RAM size in megabytes.
- `ssh_key_ids` (List of Number) SSH key IDs installed on the server.
- `state` (String) Server state (e.g. Active, Busy).
- `tags` (Set of String) Set of tags.
- `volumes` (Attributes List) Volumes attached to the server. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers--volumes))

<a id="nestedatt--servers--nics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `servers.nics`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) NIC ID.
- `ip_address` (String) IP address.
- `mac` (String) MAC address.
- `network_id` (String) Connected network ID.


<a id="nestedatt--servers--volumes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `servers.volumes`

Read-Only:

- `created` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (Number) Volume ID.
- `name` (String) Volume name.
- `size_mb` (Number) Volume size in megabytes.
